name: Alexy
source:
Alexy is a cheerful and energetic boy attending Sweet Amoris. He joins the school in together with his twin brother Armin.
He isn't datable in the game, due to the fact that he prefers boys. However, he can be one of heroine's closest friends.
translation:
Alexy is a cheerful and energetic boy attending Sweet Amoris. He joins the school in together with his twin brother Armin.
He isn't datable in the game, due to the fact that he prefers boys. However, he can be one of heroine's closest friends.
